verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an office suite, but the evidence pack never documents a way to bind actions to document or application events. The only related items are adjacent. The macro:// start parameter runs a macro once, when a file is opened from the command line. UNO API and SDK extension access are developer building blocks, not a rules/trigger capability. Neither counts as a recurring, user-defined event trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
